objectives: Describe what happened to Dinah and the lesson for fathers.
Explain why Hamor's offer went against the law.
Explain the zeal of Simeon and Levi.
takeaways: Keep watch over the daughters: have a care of their body, and give not overmuch liberty (Ecclesiasticus 42:9-11).
Shechem wrought folly in Israel, which ought not to be done; the laws were kept long before Sinai.
Make ye marriages with us and become one people: assimilation is the offer the nations always make, and the law forbids it.
The sword of Simeon was given of God to take vengeance of the strangers that defiled the maid (Judith 9:2-4).
Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot? There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel (Deuteronomy 23:17).
